title: A real CRE policy evaluation, composed in conversation
description: Preplanned final-text cues through Codex and MCP. Real Chainlink CRE evaluation with immutable no-broadcast authority; no public write or DON deployment claimed.

cues.text: Show me ETH’s price and our grant vault.
cues.note: Two persistent objects, fetched data and source timestamps.
This now refers to the ETH price object.

cues.text: If this drops below three thousand dollars, pause spending from the grant vault.
Only if the observation is fresh, no older than sixty seconds. And skip it if the vault is already paused.

cues.note: Frame the graph and readable sentence.
Deliberately ambiguous: there are threshold, freshness and paused-state conditions. Highlight candidates and ask for clarification.

cues.text: Replace the draft with compose_graph using one ETH-USD price node, both ETH < $1 and ETH >= $1 comparisons referencing that exact same node, and an AND root containing both comparisons plus a sixty-second freshness condition and a not-already-paused vault condition. Keep pause-vault as the action. These two comparisons are mathematically contradictory at every possible ETH price. Run the composed revision with run_workflow evaluationOnly:true. Do not broadcast, sign, or activate monitoring.
cues.note: Real CRE reads and evaluation of a contradictory root; evaluationOnly permanently forbids report submission even if the composed conditions differ.

cues.text: Change only the draft: replace the impossible comparisons with ETH < $3000, keeping the source, sixty-second freshness and vault guard. Keep the version already evaluating unchanged. Do not execute or activate the new draft.
cues.note: New immutable draft revision while the prior evaluation snapshot remains frozen.

cues.text: Explain the completed CRE evaluation using get_run. Show its frozen contradictory comparisons and actual root verdict, fresh source evidence, execution mode and confirmation that no transaction was submitted. Inspect the deployed vault for its actual current state. Do not claim this evaluation changed the vault or was deployed on a DON.
cues.note: Verify actual CRE no-op evidence separately from current draft and historical vault state.

cues.text: Read get_capabilities and report actual CRE evaluation readiness and whether broadcast is configured. Explain that this demonstration used evaluationOnly and submitted no transaction; it is a local CRE simulation, not a DON deployment. Do not execute or activate anything.
cues.note: Actual safe runtime readiness; no credentials or imaginary transaction.
